ALL four candidates fail validateRuntimeMapPackage() (exact 200x200 @ TILE=16) and core.ts fixed 40,000-cell grid. Missing: approved biome mapping, swept clearance, cart/ferry rules, exposure sim, streaming, human 640x360 test.

• 9 au road/river strokes + 13x7.2 au bridge glyph = EDITOR geometry, NOT physical widths.
• 3.696 au entrance / 57.4232 au² workspace = GEO-02 PROPOSED, NOT canonical.

MAP DESIGNS THE PHYSICAL WORLD. GAMEPLAY POPULATES AND SIMULATES IT. · No fabricated travel time, no invented collision rule, no incomplete trail labelled cart-passable.
